title: Slit Diaphragm Molecular Architecture & Inherited Podocytopathies Masterclass
description: 整合足細胞裂隙膜 (Slit Diaphragm) 分子結構 (Nephrin, Podocin, CD2AP, TRPC6)、單基因病變 (NPHS1, NPHS2) 與 FSGS 之專科課程。

sections.title: Module 1: Slit Diaphragm Molecular Architecture (Nephrin, Podocin, CD2AP, TRPC6)
sections.content:
### 1. Slit Diaphragm Protein Complex Matrix

| Protein Component | Gene | Subcellular Localization | Interacting Partners | Human Phenotype / Disease Association |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Nephrin | NPHS1 (19q13.1) | Transmembrane Slit Diaphragm Core | Podocin, CD2AP, Fyn Kinase | Congenital Nephrotic Syndrome of the Finnish Type (CNSF) |
| Podocin | NPHS2 (1q25-q31) | Hairpin-like Membrane Raft Protein | Nephrin, CD2AP, Glut1 | Autosomal Recessive Steroid-Resistant Nephrotic Syndrome (SRNS) / FSGS |
| CD2AP | CD2AP | Cytoplasmic Adaptor Protein | Nephrin, F-Actin Cytoskeleton | Susceptibility to FSGS & Proteinuria |
| TRPC6 | TRPC6 (11q21-q22) | Plasma Membrane Cation Channel | Podocin, Nephrin | Autosomal Dominant FSGS (Gain-of-Function Mutations) |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature | NPHS1 Mutation (Nephrin Defect) | NPHS2 Mutation (Podocin Defect) | TRPC6 Mutation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Inheritance Pattern | Autosomal Recessive | Autosomal Recessive | Autosomal Dominant |
| Onset Age | Congenital (In utero / Birth to 3 Months) | Early Childhood (1–5 Years) or Adult Onset | Adult Onset (Adolescence to Adulthood) |
| Steroid Responsiveness | Completely Steroid-Resistant | Completely Steroid-Resistant | Steroid-Resistant |
| Post-Transplant Recurrence Risk | Low (< 5%), Unless Anti-Nephrin Antibodies Form | Extremely Low (< 2–5%) | Very Low (No Autoimmune Circulating Factor) |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

NPHS1 Mutation ➔ Absence of Functional Nephrin Homodimers ➔ Complete Disruption of Slit Diaphragm Porous Structure ➔ Massive In Utero Albumin Permeability ➔ Congenital Nephrotic Syndrome (Finnish Type) with Marked Placental Megaly & Severe Proteinuria at Birth.

TRPC6 Gain-of-Function Mutation ➔ Excessive Intracellular Calcium Influx into Podocytes ➔ Activation of Calcineurin & Depolymerization of Actin Cytoskeleton ➔ Foot Process Effacement & Podocyte Detachment ➔ Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis (FSGS).

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為所有遺傳性單基因足細胞病變 (Genetic SRNS) 在腎移植後都有高復發率。
**Analysis**: 遺傳性 SRNS (如 NPHS1 或 NPHS2 雙等位突變) 由於原發病因為受體自身的基因缺陷，移植同種異體正常腎臟後，缺乏內在循環致病因子 (Circulating Permeability Factors)，因此移植後 FSGS 復發率極低 (< 5%)。反觀原發特發性 FSGS (Idiopathic FSGS) 因帶有 SuPAR 或其他 Circulating Factors，移植後復發率高達 30–50%。

sections.title: Module 2: APOL1 High-Risk Variants & Podocyte Injury Pathways
sections.content:
### 1. APOL1 Allelic Variant Matrix

| APOL1 Variant | Sequence Change | Evolutionary Origin | Kidney Disease Risk (Recessive Model) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| G0 (Wild-type) | Baseline Ancestral Allele | Protective against Trypanosoma brucei brucei | Baseline Normal Risk |
| G1 (High-Risk) | Two Amino Acid Substitution (S342G and I384M) | Evolutionary Selection for Resistance to Trypanosoma brucei rhodesiense | ~7-10 fold Increased Risk of FSGS & HIVAN (with 2 High-Risk Alleles: G1/G1, G2/G2, G1/G2) |
| G2 (High-Risk) | Two Amino Acid Deletion (N388/Y389 deletion) | Evolutionary Selection for Resistance to Trypanosoma brucei rhodesiense | ~7-10 fold Increased Risk of FSGS, HIVAN, & Hypertensive Nephrosclerosis |

### 2. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Presence of Two APOL1 High-Risk Alleles (G1/G1, G2/G2, G1/G2) + Environmental Second Hit (Interferon Activation / HIV / Viral Infection) ➔ Upregulation of APOL1 Expression ➔ APOL1 Protein Inserts into Podocyte Endolysosomal & Plasma Membranes ➔ Cation-Permeable Pore Formation ➔ Potassium Efflux & Calcium Influx ➔ Lysosomal Swelling & Mitochondrial Dysfunction ➔ Podocyte Apoptosis & FSGS Progression.

### 3. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為只要帶有單一 APOL1 G1 或 G2 高風險等位基因 (Heterozygous / 1 High-Risk Allele)，就會引發 FSGS。
**Analysis**: APOL1 相關腎病遵循隱性模式 (Autosomal Recessive Pattern of Risk)。單一高風險等位基因 (G1/G0 或 G2/G0) 不會顯著增加腎病風險；必須同時帶有兩個高風險等位基因 (G1/G1, G2/G2, 或 G1/G2)，且常需加上第二擊 (Second Hit，如病毒感染或干擾素刺激)，才會大幅提高 FSGS 與 HIVAN 之風險。
